mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 58 degrees. We also have a Full Moon tonight, and the ISS will be passing overhead, though you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Planning Department is reminding everyone that they do not accept online payments for fees. Always verify that emails end in veronawi.gov, and pay by check at the City Administration Building. Additionally, fall leaf pickup begins on October 5, so remember to keep piles clear of obstacles and out of the street.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Today, enjoy Verona Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol and more live music at Paddy Mac's.
Regarding local activity, on September 5, police responded to a report of vehicles having cheese slices placed on their windshields, which was identified as a social media prank.
It is time for a treat, as Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM with today's flavor of the day available for everyone.
